driver: STM32N6 RCC low-level (LL) driver - delivered code (brownfield, feature 008)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 14 + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.14 RCC register interface + memory map p.176 (owner decision 2026-10-15)
target.safety_allocation: OUT_OF_SCOPE: QM development, no safety allocation or safety claims (owner decision 2026-10-15)

scope: LL (header-only, static inline, (void) functions): read/write RCC registers through the generated register-block array ll_rcc_regs (extern; placed at the RCC base by the linker, defined in RAM by host tests), indexed by the generated LL_RCC_<REG>_OFFSET / 4U
HSI and HSE oscillator enable/disable (RCC_CR HSION/HSEON or their set/clear registers) and ready-flag query in RCC_SR (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)
Peripheral clock enable/disable/is-enabled for AHB1-5 and APB1L/1H/2/4L/4H/5 enable registers (RCC_xxxENR, RM0486 14.10.79-14.10.90)
Out of scope: HAL API (status codes, parameter checks, timeouts - work order 0002b), PLL configuration, clock tree switching, security/privilege configuration, interrupts, low-power modes

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
